scope: P2 source-backed development panel. Not a completed benchmark, mechanism ground truth, or admitted execution input.
remaining_panel_gaps: Freeze conditions, numeric targets, acceptance thresholds and held-out partition before predictions.
Add a neutral homogeneous-solution case within the present lane scope.
Add a separately sourced solvent-assisted mechanism challenge.
Complete experimental uncertainty and applicability review; unknown uncertainties are not zero.

cases.system: Cyclopentadiene dimerization in a light hydrocarbon fraction
cases.source_location: Printed pages 19–20; rate constants listed immediately before Table 2
cases.rate_convention: Reported slope of reciprocal CPD concentration versus time; do not equate directly to elementary reaction-extent rate for 2 CPD -> dimer.
limitations: Solvent is a hydrocarbon fraction, not a declared pure solvent; do not substitute hexane silently.
Reaction pressure is not the reported chromatography carrier pressure.
Resolve concentration-loss versus reaction-extent factor of two before scoring.
Table concentration trajectories require visual transcription review.
Not a frozen benchmark or validation of the current implicit-solution lane.
The table's delta-percent entries compare reference values; they are not confidence intervals.
The fitted net rate is not evidence of a single elementary reaction.
NaOH implies ionic species and a counterion; the current neutral-solution lane must not silently admit this case.
Pressure, activity, solvent composition and systematic uncertainty require further review.
Any lifetime calculated from these rates is a model-derived comparator, not an independently measured lifetime.

cases.system: OH + H2O2 in a nitrogen expansion
limitations: The HTML abstract has malformed uncertainty notation; no numeric uncertainty was inferred.
Bath density and publication metadata need full-paper verification.
Observed products do not establish a concerted rather than stepwise microscopic mechanism.
Electronic-structure challenge classification is a benchmark-design hypothesis, not a conclusion established by the experimental abstract.

cases.observed_ordering: anti more reactive than syn toward NO/NO2 under the reported experiment
limitations: The authors explicitly cannot determine accurate absolute rate coefficients because probe and photolysis volumes differ.
Do not equate observed total decay with a pure unimolecular rate or assume rapid conformer equilibration.
Retain qualitative ordering as a challenge; an independent quantitative source is required for rate scoring.

cases.system: beta-myrcene + acrylic acid in ethyl acetate or toluene
cases.source_location: Main Table 2, printed page 122; SI Table S1, page S5; SI Equations S1-S3, page S3; experimental procedure, page 125
cases.rate_convention: Apparent reciprocal-myrcene-concentration slope under near-equimolar approximation; not automatically an elementary-channel rate.
limitations: Batch reaction uses sealed microwave vials; batch pressure is unreported, and flow-reactor pressure must not be substituted.
Reactant concentrations are 2.8-2.9 mol/L and myrcene stock purity is 90%; concentrated-solution activities, acid association and unknown impurities require assessment.
Unknown experimental uncertainty is not zero. Do not derive a confidence interval from table rounding or temperature variation.
Numeric observations are frozen, but execution conditions, budget, applicability and thresholds have not been preregistered; no scoring record is admitted.

cases.system: Furan + maleimide and reversible endo/exo adduct formation in acetonitrile-d3
cases.source_location: Tables 2-3, page 6298; experimental procedure, page 6296; model and fitting caveats, pages 6297-6299
cases.fit_uncertainty_convention: Source-reported joint confidence limits at probability 0.9545; not independent marginal Gaussian errors or complete experimental uncertainty.
limitations: Numerical initial concentrations are not needed to retain source-fitted rate coefficients, but are not supplied as exact execution inputs for concentration-time, lifetime or product-distribution tests.
Keep the actual deuterated solvent; do not silently replace CD3CN by ordinary CH3CN.
Published values are coefficients of the authors' reversible concentration-law model, not verified microscopic mechanism ground truth or activity-based intrinsic constants.
Joint covariance, complete systematic uncertainty and reaction pressure are not supplied; the authors note NMR calibration/mass-balance limitations.
Retained primary-paper visual reproductions are hashed; a complete original publisher or author PDF has not been archived.
No acceptance protocol, autonomous execution request, support promotion or prospective holdout is admitted by this source audit.

reference_uncertainty.interpretation: Evaluator-assigned envelope, not a rigorous experimental confidence interval. Section 1.2 uses approximate standard-deviation language; Section 2.6 describes a two-sigma coverage objective. Neither supplies an exact probability model.

provenance.citation: Sander et al., Chemical Kinetics and Photochemical Data for Use in Atmospheric Studies, Evaluation Number 17, JPL Publication 10-6 (2011).
provenance.source_location: Table 2-1 B1, printed page 2-4; table units, air and f(T) footnotes, page 2-7; complete B1 note, page 2-8.

limitations: Rate-only high-pressure limit at 300 K, not a finite-pressure decay, falloff, lifetime, product distribution or complete gas validation case.
Theory-informed historical JPL Evaluation 17 recommendation, not an independent experimentally measured high-pressure point or a claim to use the latest evaluation.
JPL evaluated uncertainty envelope is not a calibrated STORCA error factor or an exact probability distribution; complete experimental uncertainty remains unknown.
No applicable capture provider, coupled entrance surface, execution budget, acceptance threshold, holdout or support claim is established by this frozen reference.
